newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile Oct industrial output up 6.7 pct vs year ago.
newsitem.headline: Chile Oct industrial output up 6.7 pct vs year ago.

text.p: Chilean industrial production rose 6.7 percent in October comapred with the same month last year, with sales rising seven percent over the same period, said the National Statistics Institute.
Areas with the greatest increases in output included tobacco, up 72 percent, iron and steel, up 17 percent, and the chemical industry, up 12 percent.
Falls in production were seen in the non-electric machinery industry, down 18 percent, leather products, down 10 percent, and the plastics industry, down three percent.
